messages:
alex: Morning — I'm Alex, new on Inference. Trying to access the cluster `redwood-dev` but `kubectl get pods -n inference-dev` returns `Error from server (Forbidden)`. Can someone help grant me the right RBAC or point me to the right flow? I'm onboarding today.

jen (devex): welcome @alex! :wave: Pinging @devops-ian — they handle RBAC. Quick Q: what's your company email and GitHub handle?

devops-ian: hey @alex, welcome. I can add you to the `inference-devs` group or create a short-lived user binding. What's your preferred identity?

alex: email: alex@redwood.ai, github: alexng. Prefer using my SSO email.

maya: approving — maya here, I manage the inference team. +1 for view access in `inference-dev`.

devops-ian: thanks @maya. I'll do a user RoleBinding to `view` in `inference-dev` for now and follow up to convert to group-based binding. Preview of what I'll apply:

```yaml
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: RoleBinding
metadata:
  name: view-inference-alexng
  namespace: inference-dev
subjects:
- kind: User
  name: "alex@redwood.ai"
  apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io
roleRef:
  kind: ClusterRole
  name: view
  apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io
```

I'll create a ticket and apply this, should take a couple minutes.

ops-bot: INFRA-1023 created by devops-ian: "RBAC: view binding for alex@redwood.ai in inference-dev". Status: in-progress.

devops-ian: applied. You can test with:

`kubectl config use-context redwood-dev && kubectl auth can-i get pods -n inference-dev --as alex@redwood.ai`

You should see `yes`. If not, paste the exact error here.

alex: running the check now... got `yes` — I can list pods. Thank you!! :tada:

jen (devex): added link to the onboarding doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/onboarding/k8s-access — covers contexts, namespaces, and the request process.

devops-ian: note for records: this is a temporary user-level binding; we'll convert to SSO group binding next week (so future requests go through the standard group).

alex: perfect, that solves it. Appreciate the quick help everyone!

jen (devex): if you run into permission issues (can't describe, port-forward etc.) open the ticket thread or DM me. Congrats on day 1 :coffee:
